result.topic_en: Pencil notes written upside down on the back of a printed table form (columns No. der Karte, Zeichen, Stück, Pfund, Loth). They include small sketches of closed curves and loops, some drawn in red, apparently showing curves on a Riemann surface; the Kurrent text is largely illegible and heavily struck through.
